{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&DIntensityVolatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by average total assets", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile R&D investments may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or failures, leading to divergent future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "AdvertisingEfficiency", "construction": "ratio of advertising expenses to sales growth over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising efficiency may have a competitive advantage, while those with low efficiency may be wasting resources", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "EmployeeGrowthAcceleration", "construction": "difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of total employees", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating employee growth may be experiencing rapid expansion or improving operational efficiency", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "TangibleAssetObsolescence", "construction": "ratio of depreciation expense to gross property, plant, and equipment over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high tangible asset obsolescence may be at risk of technological disruption or declining industry trends", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "CashFlowVariance", "construction": "variance of operating cash flows over the past 5 years", "rationale": "!Firms with high cash flow variance may be more susceptible to economic downturns or industry disruptions", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "InstitutionalOwnershipConcentration", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman index of institutional ownership over the past quarter", "rationale": "Firms with high institutional ownership concentration may be subject to decreased liquidity or increased price pressure", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "DirectorOptionGrants", "construction": "ratio of total director option grants to total shares outstanding over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high director option grants may be incentivizing managers to take excessive risks", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "CustomerBaseDiversification", "construction": "ratio of sales to the top 5 customers to total sales over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with low customer base diversification may be vulnerable to customer concentration risk", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "GeographicSegmentDiversification", "construction": "ratio of foreign sales to total sales over the past year, scaled by the number of geographic segments", "rationale": "Firms with high geographic segment diversification may be better insulated from regional economic shocks", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "SupplyChainLeverage", "construction": "ratio of cost of goods sold to total assets over the past year, scaled by the number of suppliers", "rationale": "Firms with high supply chain leverage may be more exposed to supplier risk or input price volatility", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
